what_the_files_show: LIM-0029 allows machine translation for comparator legal texts only, but the cases also rely on the Moldovan Court of Accounts reports (MDA-GOV-2024-001, -003), Montenegrin government reports (MNE-GOV-2025-002, -003, MNE-GOV-2026-003) and the explanatory statement in a Croatian bill. decision_needed: Validate comparator relevance for the nine cases?
what_the_files_show: RI-FMW-001: Croatia High, Montenegro High, Serbia Medium. RI-TEC-028: Moldova, Serbia and Montenegro all Medium (Montenegro lowered from High after the check, so this issue has no closely matching case). Montenegro on RI-FMW-001 is the closest call: only Article 178a bears directly on the issue and its timing is unknown, while the quota carve-out belongs to RI-FMW-002.

decision_needed: Accept that the cases show what was tried, not what worked?
what_the_files_show: Of 21 success judgements, 18 are insufficient_evidence, 1 too_early and 2 worked. The two worked rows are narrow: Albania removed one reporting overlap between two bodies, and Montenegro's portal improved information. Neither concerns use or access. No case shows that a reform raised platform use or changed EU workers' access. A revision brief applied a stricter test than the judgement rules (no measure, no success judgement), which would have left no worked row; the coordinator restored the two rows and two attribution values, because the rules bar government reporting alone but do not require a measure.
agent_recommendation: Validate as proposed, keeping the two narrow worked rows, and state this limit plainly in the briefs.
what_changes: Any policy option must present comparator evidence as design options and warnings, not as proven routes. Removing the two rows would change no conclusion on use.

decision_needed: What may draft policy options draw on?
what_the_files_show: Sources state few lessons: 5 items carry a transferability judgement (4 conditional, 1 unlikely), none on RI-FMW-001, and only 3 are typed as lessons. The practical lessons in the nine cases are agent synthesis and are labelled so. Transferability can attach only to an item (data dictionary), so these case-level lessons have no judgement behind them, while Codebook 7 requires a transferability judgement and conditions for each option.
agent_recommendation: Option A: allow one transferability judgement per case, attached to the case (data dictionary 1.4), proposed as conditional, using the case's transferable and not-transferable fields as its conditions, and label them agent synthesis in every output. Option B: use only the 5 item-level judgements, which leaves RI-FMW-001 with no option.
what_changes: The main choice at this gate. Option A gives options on all three issues but rests them on the tool's synthesis, for you to validate. Option B is stricter and yields fewer options.

decision_needed: Validate the case-level lessons and transferable and not-transferable statements?
what_the_files_show: Main lessons, all conditional. RI-FMW-001: EU equal treatment can sit in a separate regime in the foreigners law, but commencement on accession is untested; permit simplification alone does not address the gap (Serbia). RI-TEC-028: legal duties and sanctions may exist without evidence that they raise use (Moldova); connection counts do not show regular use, and connected and active counts can move separately (Montenegro, on two government figures). RI-TEC-036: counts of digital services say little about use (Moldova); a duty on institutions can sit alongside payment that often fails (Albania); a portal without the most-needed services may improve information only (Montenegro, too early).
agent_recommendation: Validate as conditional hypotheses, subject to G6b-D05.
what_changes: Only validated cases and lessons may be used for draft policy options (P4).
